cleanInstall.command: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-fund --no-audit in an isolated release-check directory

publicHistory.method: Explicit source allowlist and independently scanned parentless foundation plus actual scoped changes; private ancestry preserved locally
publicHistory.credentialTransport: Existing authenticated GitHub credential helper; no credentials embedded in remote URLs or source

limitations: Dependency advisory databases change; zero reported advisories is not a security certification.
Pattern scanning and explicit file allowlisting are complementary checks, not a proof that all secrets are detectable.
Package byte size is a dry-run observation before the final documentation update.
